title: Eastern Name Order: Family Name First

sections.content:
Unlike Western European languages, Hungarian uses the **Eastern name order** (family name first, given name second):
- **Kovács Péter** (Family name: *Kovács*, Given name: *Péter*)
- **Nagy Anna** (Family name: *Nagy*, Given name: *Anna*)
- **Szabó Zoltán** (Family name: *Szabó*, Given name: *Zoltán*)

When introducing yourself in Hungarian, you always state your family name first: *Kovács Péter vagyok.*

sections.title: Hungarian Names: Family Name + Given Name

items.english: My name is Katalin Horváth (family name Horváth).

items.spanish: Hivatalos iratokban mindig a családnév áll az első helyen.
